title: Sheehan gets access to every internal Scientology file

tellings.quote: I said that look I wouldn't even meet with Ron hubard unless there was a condition precedent that I could be given access to every single document anywhere in the world uh in internal files of the Church of Scientology

plain: In the 1970s the lawyer Dan Sheehan says he refused to meet L. Ron Hubbard, the founder of the Church of Scientology, unless he was first given access to "every single document anywhere in the world" in the church's internal files. Sheehan tells it himself, saying this included the files of the Guardian's Office, the church's internal security and legal arm, and he names Hubbard's wife Mary Sue Hubbard in the account. It would mean an outsider saw the church's most private records.
